text:
Good morning - asking those that visit the Hadera Branch of MH

Years ago , there was a kiosk downstairs that offered a quick service for passport photos - is it still there ? 

I have an appointment with my mother on Sunday , she will need a passport photo for the opening of her file . She is 88 and in a wheelchair . I would rather not have to take her to another town , this week, to get one of these done if this kiosk still exists . 

Thanks for any recent information 🙏🏻🙏🏻🌸
